title: Rhode Island (RI) Counties
text:
Rhode Island (RI) Counties

FIPS codes for Rhode Island.

FIPS State Code: 44

Enter the U.S. country code (01) followed by the state and county code.

For example, for Bristol County, enter 
01-44001.
 

| FIPS County Code | County Name |
| --- | --- |
| 001 | Bristol |
| 003 | Kent |
| 005 | Newport |
| 007 | Providence |
| 009 | Washington |
